missing_information_behavior: Check current B12 products, dose, adherence and fortified-food intake before suggesting an additional product.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim methylcobalamin is clinically superior to cyanocobalamin without evidence.
Do not duplicate existing B12 supplementation.
Do not infer deficiency from vegan status alone.
professional_escalation_conditions: Neurological symptoms, pernicious anemia, malabsorption, gastrointestinal surgery, pregnancy or abnormal B12-related labs.
population_and_context: Vegan users with little or no fortified-food intake considering methylcobalamin; a reliable B12 source is important, but methylcobalamin is not automatically superior to other effective forms.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; verify total reliable B12 intake and assess suspected deficiency clinically.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS B12 fact sheet describes B12 sources and forms; it does not establish routine superiority of methylcobalamin. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
